title: Targeted transfection of cells/tissue in vivo
protocol: Vortex In vivo PolyMag vial before each use.
Add the required volume of In vivo PolyMag to a sterile microtube according to DNA amount needed.
Pre-dilute an aliquot of In vivo PolyMag reagent with deionized water for less than 1 µg DNA doses, and discard after use.
Dilute DNA in the final injection volume in a sterile vial.
Mix DNA solution immediately with In vivo PolyMag by pipetting up and down.
Incubate complexes for 20 min at room temperature.
Place magnet on targeted tissue before injection.
Slowly inject complexes into the target area.
Let the magnet stand from 5 min to 1 h after injection.
Monitor gene expression at appropriate time points.
Prepare DNA solution by diluting it in half of the injection volume with saline buffer.
Incubate diluted DNA for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Mix Dogtor reagent before use and dilute it in half of the injection volume.
Incubate diluted Dogtor for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Vortex In vivo CombiMag reagent before each use.
Use 1 μL of In vivo CombiMag per μg DNA without dilution, or pre-dilute an aliquot with deionized water if less than 1 μg DNA is used.
Combine DNA solution with Dogtor solution and mix gently.
Incubate mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add In vivo CombiMag reagent to the DNA/Dogtor mixture.
Mix gently and incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Place magnet on targeted tissue.
Slowly inject the complexes.
Let the magnet stand from 5 minutes to 1 hour.
